proposals.reason: Bank statement exports often label the bank's own reference simply 'Reference'.
proposals.risk: HIGH - ambiguous: IN-09 also has end_to_end_ref, and exports use 'Reference' for either. Must not be approved alongside AP-IN-09-REFERENCE-E2E.
proposals.origin: Phase 2 hand-written proposal (domain reasoning from UC-042 column descriptions)

proposals.reason: Some payment exports use 'Reference' for the end-to-end (payer) reference.
proposals.risk: HIGH - ambiguous with AP-IN-09-REFERENCE-BANKREF (same header, different field). Both approved together would make 'Reference' ambiguous; the loader rejects that.
proposals.origin: Phase 2 hand-written proposal (domain reasoning from UC-042 column descriptions)

proposals.reason: Common bank-export label for the C/D indicator.
proposals.risk: HIGH - sign perspective: IN-09 is bank perspective (C = money in) while IN-10 cash book is ledger perspective (D = money in) (uc042lib.money). The same label in a cash-book export would invert signs.
proposals.origin: Phase 2 hand-written proposal (domain reasoning from UC-042 column descriptions)

proposals.reason: Balance confirmations often show a single 'Balance' column.
proposals.risk: MEDIUM - IN-08 carries opening and closing balances; a single 'Balance' column could be either. The value is unsigned (sign in balance_dc_indicator).
proposals.origin: Phase 2 hand-written proposal (domain reasoning from UC-042 column descriptions)

proposals.reason: Internal reconciliation reports usually title the result 'Difference'.
proposals.risk: MEDIUM - IN-06 also has difference_reported with the opposite definition (bank minus ledger, versus resource minus requirement).
proposals.origin: Phase 2 hand-written proposal (domain reasoning from UC-042 column descriptions)
